display_name: Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF

about.en: BOTZ is the Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF, sponsored by Global X, which invests in companies that stand to benefit from the adoption of robotics and artificial intelligence, including industrial robotics, automation and autonomous vehicles. Each share represents an interest in the fund's portfolio. Its shares trade on Nasdaq as BOTZ; it is distinct from Global X's UCITS fund of the same name listed in Europe.
